# Security policy

Please do not disclose a suspected vulnerability in a public GitHub issue.

Report it through the Sharemarium contact form at
https://www.sharemarium.com/contact and begin the subject with `[SECURITY]`.
Include the affected URL, the observed behavior, and safe reproduction steps.
Do not include real users' personal information, access tokens, passwords, or
database contents.

The operator will acknowledge the report as soon as practical, assess impact,
and coordinate remediation before public disclosure.
